ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity pixels are mapped primarily to the trailing edge boundaries, distal tips, and a dense network of linear streaks crisscrossing the high-intensity central zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with a sharp pixel-defined vertex and symmetrical divergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, sweeping from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme leading-edge corners of both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense distribution of distinct, multi-directional low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) overlaying the high-intensity pigmentation of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant barnacle clusters on distal tips and extensive rake mark scarring across the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible water spray/agitation at the base of the fluke where it meets the water line.
